description:
Speak, don't type

Speak naturally, and Typeless will turn your words into polished messages, emails, and documents that read like you carefully typed them - in real time. 4x faster than typing.
Cloud Sync for your history

Your history can stay with you from one device to the next with Cloud Sync. A thought captured on your computer is available on your phone when you need it on the go, and vice versa. Your latest dictations stay within reach in History as you work across devices.
Turn on Cloud Sync in History and choose how long to keep your history in the cloud.
Thanks for using Typeless. We hope this update makes it easier to keep your thoughts moving wherever your work takes you.
